rv.q: This much explanation was required, because, as sound designer Martha Knight, who opened the show with a preamble, put it, “watching a game that you don’t understand is the opposite of a good time”. Further, at the end, A and B must decide what happens.

The result is a spontaneous and unpredictable performance that means no two shows are ever going to be the same, with instinct playing a part as the players decide how and when their story ends. Attention is a queer love story between two people named only as A and B.
Not understanding all the rules of engagement was a disadvantage, as I couldn’t fully experience the narrative.
